public_rationale: He says Microsoft did not actually bring online the gigawatt it said it "added" in its latest quarter (January to March 2026). Microsoft's transcripts say it "added another gigawatt" and, before that, "nearly 1 GW". They never say the capacity was energized and in use, and that wording is exactly what he disputes, so they cannot settle the question. Later, Microsoft said it added 88 data centers in FY2026 (implying 57 in the first three quarters) but gave no megawatts or status for them. Independent satellite tracking by Epoch AI shows some Microsoft capacity going live in the quarter, for example its SAT14 site in Texas. But that tracking covers only part of Microsoft's estate and little of its leased capacity. No source in hand measures Microsoft's live capacity added in the quarter, so the claim can be neither confirmed nor refuted.
limitations: The claim turns on what "added" means, and Microsoft never defined it.
Leased capacity from neoclouds and colocation firms is largely invisible to public trackers.

our_interpretation: Read as a claim about the quarter Microsoft referred to when it said it "added another gigawatt": fiscal Q3 2026 (January to March 2026), the latest quarter reported before the post. The word "another" also points back to the prior quarter's "nearly 1 GW" (October to December 2025). That quarter is context, not a separate assertion.

"Brought online" means capacity that was energized and usable for Microsoft's workloads during the quarter, whether owned or leased. Capacity that was only contracted, or still in construction, does not count.
Microsoft's own use of the word "added" cannot settle the dispute, because the dispute is over what that word means.
criteria.support_condition: Independent evidence (satellite tracking, filings, utility or permit records, credible reporting) showing that Microsoft's energized, usable capacity grew by well under about 1 GW in January to March 2026, or a Microsoft statement that the gigawatt was contracted or under construction rather than live.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An explicit Microsoft statement that about 1 GW became live or in service in that quarter, or independent tallies showing about 1 GW of Microsoft-used capacity (owned or leased) energized between January and March 2026.
